title: Behind the Curtain — The Pyramid of Power
subtitle: From public authority through access brokers and continuity networks to the unresolved symbolic apex
editorialBoundary: This model maps documented authority, ownership, appointments, capital, infrastructure, intelligence access, policy influence, access brokerage and institutional continuity. It separates fact, inference, disputed claims and symbolic interpretation.

updatePolicy.refreshRule: When reviewed evidence changes a role, tier score, ownership path, family-control structure or relationship, rebuild the model and preserve previous state.

viewModes.label: Show Only What Can Be Proven

levels.name: The Lightbringer
levels.question: Is the final ruler a person, an entity, an ideology or the system itself?
levels.thesis: The apex is an open symbolic hypothesis: illumination, false light, technological transcendence, elite self-perception, spiritual claim or the impersonal logic of the machine.
levels.counterweight: No empirical record establishes a supernatural being as the operational commander of the named human network.

levels.name: The Human Apex
levels.question: Which living people combine the greatest breadth and intensity of documented access?
levels.thesis: Calculated from all tier-specific scores. It ranks reach, not secret rulership or moral worth.
mechanisms: Current enforceable office or executive authority
levels.counterweight: No score proves total control. Every candidate remains constrained by institutions, law, markets, succession, rivals and implementation.

levels.name: The Inner Councils Question
levels.kicker: Verified bodies and alleged coordinating centres
levels.question: Where do high-level decisions become collective, private or technically insulated?
levels.thesis: Actual councils, boards and committees are named and then tested against claims of a single command structure.
levels.counterweight: No single supreme human council has been verified; named bodies have different mandates, members, vetoes and rival interests.

levels.name: The Thirteen Families Claim
levels.question: Is thirteen a verified command structure, a symbolic number or a later synthesis?
levels.thesis: Thirteen dynastic structures and historical houses are compared because they recur in continuity claims. Inclusion does not establish a council of thirteen.
levels.counterweight: The record does not establish a unified council of exactly thirteen families controlling all major systems.

levels.name: Dynastic and Hereditary Networks
levels.question: Which families retain enforceable authority, voting control or continuity across generations?
levels.thesis: The strongest family power appears where succession, voting rights, trusts, foundations or holding companies legally preserve control.
levels.counterweight: Family-level control is usually sectoral or jurisdictional, not proof of command over unrelated states and institutions.

levels.name: The Connectors and Access Brokers
levels.question: Who repeatedly connects capital, government, technology, philanthropy and policy networks?
levels.thesis: Connector power is assessed through documented offices, boards, investment relationships and government access. It is influence and access, not automatic command.
levels.counterweight: Connection is not command. Every pathway must identify the actual office, transaction, board right or advisory relationship.

levels.name: The Policy Architects
levels.question: Who develops the frameworks that later enter policy, regulation and institutional practice?
levels.thesis: This tier names leaders of institutions that research, finance, convene, advise or operationalise policy before and around formal public decisions.
levels.counterweight: A proposal, paper, meeting or grant does not prove adoption, control or a shared secret agenda.

levels.name: Intelligence, Security and Covert Capability
levels.kicker: Information and force outside ordinary visibility
levels.question: Who can see what the public cannot and authorise exceptional capabilities?
levels.thesis: This tier maps current publicly documented intelligence, security and military command roles without converting secrecy into proof of unlimited power.
levels.counterweight: A public command role does not prove private agendas, unlawful conduct or control beyond legal and institutional authority.

levels.name: Ownership and Critical Infrastructure
levels.kicker: The rails society cannot easily replace
levels.question: Who governs compute, chips, cloud, payments, energy and logistics?
levels.thesis: This tier names executives and controllers of systems that states, markets and citizens cannot quickly replace.
levels.counterweight: Critical firms remain interdependent and constrained by boards, shareholders, regulators, customers, suppliers and states.

levels.name: Money and Capital Gatekeepers
levels.question: Who can create, allocate, price, custody or deny capital?
levels.thesis: This tier separates public monetary authority, delegated fiduciary control, sovereign investment and private banking power.
levels.counterweight: Assets under management are not personal property, and most financial decisions are committee-based, regulated or client-mandated.

levels.name: The Permanent Administrative System
levels.question: Who preserves continuity, standards and operational memory?
levels.thesis: This tier names institutional leaders whose organisations survive electoral turnover and retain procedures, data, mandates, relationships and implementation capacity.
levels.counterweight: Continuity is not proof of a unified deep state; institutions compete, fail, fragment and remain legally bounded.

levels.name: The Public Stage
levels.question: Who appears to govern?
levels.thesis: Visible leaders possess real authority, but their mandates are temporary, divided and dependent on institutions, advisers, capital and implementation systems.
levels.counterweight: Visibility is not the same as ownership, permanence or unrestricted control.

pathways.title: The symbolic ascent

symbolicDossiers.name: The Lightbringer
symbolicDossiers.summary: A contested archetype of illumination, forbidden knowledge, rebellion, technology, elite self-conception and false light.
symbolicDossiers.historicalFrame: Meanings vary across sources, periods and traditions.
symbolicDossiers.modernUse: Used as a model for hierarchy, sacrifice, secrecy, illumination or institutional continuity.
symbolicDossiers.notEstablished: No empirical evidence establishes the Lightbringer as the operational commander of the named human network.

symbolicDossiers.name: Lucifer / Morning Star
symbolicDossiers.summary: A term with changing textual, theological, literary and esoteric meanings.
symbolicDossiers.historicalFrame: Meanings vary across sources, periods and traditions.
symbolicDossiers.modernUse: Used as a model for hierarchy, sacrifice, secrecy, illumination or institutional continuity.
symbolicDossiers.notEstablished: Use of light or star imagery does not prove worship, membership, possession or criminal conduct.

symbolicDossiers.name: Saturn / Kronos
symbolicDossiers.summary: Associated with time, limits, law, hierarchy, agriculture and the devouring father.
symbolicDossiers.historicalFrame: Meanings vary across sources, periods and traditions.
symbolicDossiers.modernUse: Used as a model for hierarchy, sacrifice, secrecy, illumination or institutional continuity.
symbolicDossiers.notEstablished: Symbolic resemblance does not demonstrate a literal Saturnian command structure.

symbolicDossiers.name: Baal
symbolicDossiers.summary: An ancient title and group of deities later reinterpreted through polemic, theology and modern conspiracy literature.
symbolicDossiers.historicalFrame: Meanings vary across sources, periods and traditions.
symbolicDossiers.modernUse: Used as a model for hierarchy, sacrifice, secrecy, illumination or institutional continuity.
symbolicDossiers.notEstablished: The term cannot prove that modern institutions share one ancient cult.

symbolicDossiers.name: Moloch
symbolicDossiers.summary: A disputed historical subject often used as a metaphor for systems that consume human lives or future generations.
symbolicDossiers.historicalFrame: Meanings vary across sources, periods and traditions.
symbolicDossiers.modernUse: Used as a model for hierarchy, sacrifice, secrecy, illumination or institutional continuity.
symbolicDossiers.notEstablished: A metaphor of sacrifice does not prove literal ritual activity by named people.

symbolicDossiers.name: The Black Cube
symbolicDossiers.summary: A geometric motif linked by modern interpreters to Saturn, containment, law and institutional enclosure.
symbolicDossiers.historicalFrame: Meanings vary across sources, periods and traditions.
symbolicDossiers.modernUse: Used as a model for hierarchy, sacrifice, secrecy, illumination or institutional continuity.
symbolicDossiers.notEstablished: Similar geometry across cultures does not prove common authorship or command.

symbolicDossiers.name: The Pyramid
symbolicDossiers.summary: A model of hierarchy, concentration and ascent used here to organise evidence.
symbolicDossiers.historicalFrame: Meanings vary across sources, periods and traditions.
symbolicDossiers.modernUse: Used as a model for hierarchy, sacrifice, secrecy, illumination or institutional continuity.
symbolicDossiers.notEstablished: The shape itself is not evidence of conspiracy.

symbolicDossiers.name: The Architect
symbolicDossiers.summary: The figure who designs systems, rules, thresholds and durable structures while remaining less visible than public operators.
symbolicDossiers.historicalFrame: Meanings vary across sources, periods and traditions.
symbolicDossiers.modernUse: Used as a model for hierarchy, sacrifice, secrecy, illumination or institutional continuity.
symbolicDossiers.notEstablished: Architectural language alone does not identify a secret individual.

symbolicDossiers.name: The Deep State
symbolicDossiers.summary: A contested political term for durable security, administrative and institutional networks that can outlast elected governments.
symbolicDossiers.historicalFrame: Meanings vary across sources, periods and traditions.
symbolicDossiers.modernUse: Used as a model for hierarchy, sacrifice, secrecy, illumination or institutional continuity.
symbolicDossiers.notEstablished: Institutional continuity and secrecy do not by themselves establish one centrally commanded hidden state.

hiddenHandHypotheses.name: Permanent-state continuity model
hiddenHandHypotheses.thesis: Long-lived bureaucracies, security institutions, treaty systems and professional networks preserve capabilities and policy options across elections.
evidenceFor: Documented institutions, networks, symbols or relationships relevant to the model
Repeated access patterns that justify further investigation
evidenceAgainst: Competing interests, legal limits and fragmented authority
Association, symbolism and proximity do not prove command
hiddenHandHypotheses.requiredEvidence: Authenticated records, direct admissions, independently corroborated practice and a demonstrable decision or command chain.
hiddenHandHypotheses.notEstablished: The current record does not establish one unified hidden government or supreme coordinating centre.

thirteenFamiliesReview.headline: Thirteen named structures under investigation — not a verified council
thirteenFamiliesReview.method: Compare enforceable office, voting rights, ownership, succession, board influence, decline, original-source genealogy and counter-evidence.
thirteenFamiliesReview.currentFinding: The model documents several powerful dynastic structures and historically important houses. It does not verify a unified group of exactly thirteen controlling the world.
